title: AAPS CI keeps failing (dev branch)
symptom: For the past week AAPS CI build on the dev branch keeps failing. The issue is reproducible locally when building dev/fullRelease, and also occurs when building via Android Studio's 'Assemble Project'.
cause: The AAPS-CI command line builds both the app and wear simultaneously, which can sometimes cause ordering issues.
fix: Adjust AAPS-CI to build the app first, then the wear, to prevent the problem. This was implemented in PR #4139.
evidence_quote: The main difference with the AAPS-CI command line is that AAPS-CI builds both the app and wear simultaneously, which can sometimes cause ordering issues. I will adjust it so that AAPS-CI builds the app first, then the wear, which should prevent this problem.
